PowerShell(Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -match "CAN|USB Serial|COM|CH340|FTDI|CP210" } | Select-Object FriendlyName, Status, Class)

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Where-Object { $_.DeviceName -match "CH340|CP210" } | Select-Object DeviceName, DriverVersion, DriverDate, Manufacturer | Sort-Object DeviceName -Unique)

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_ReliabilityRecords -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TimeGenerated -gt \(Get-Date "2026-08-10 22:30:00"\) } | Select-Object TimeGenerated, SourceName, Message, EventIdentifier | Format-List)
